rows.g: ettha yasmā bhikkhunipakkhe saṁghassa paccekaṁ aparāmaṭṭhattā bhikkhunīnaṁ gaṇanāya bhāgo dātabboti dāyakassa adhippāyoti sijjhati, tathā dānañca bhikkhūpi gaṇetvā dinne eva yujjati.
